name: Bronchitis
overview: Bronchitis is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: In routine practice, bronchitis usually begins as an infection in the nose, ears, throat, or sinuses.
From a clinical perspective, the infection then makes its way down to the bronchi.
From a clinical perspective, symptoms include coughing up sputum, wheezing, shortness of breath, and chest pain.
